top_choice_rationale: P001 honours the optical lattice clock, a distinct invention (state-insensitive trapping of many neutral atoms at a magic wavelength) rather than a repeat of the 2005 comb or 2012 single-ion control. Its 1e-18 performance is verified by independent clock-to-clock comparisons, and the Katori and Ye two-name credit forces no exclusion within the supplied candidate. Residual costs are the lineage overlap with earlier metrology prizes and the unverified early-priority chronology for other lattice-clock groups. P002 is scientifically strong but carries the Andrei exclusion and open questions on pairing and device-level reproducibility, so it ranks second, above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGOLite/PoGO+ and XL-Calibur ties are astroparticle instrumentation with no link to Katori, Ye, Bistritzer, MacDonald or Jarillo-Herrero
